image_description: A close-up shot of a person's upper arm and shoulder area. The skin features a large, colorful temporary tattoo or sticker with floral patterns and text on the upper deltoid. Below this, two adhesive bandages (Band-Aids) are applied to the skin. One is a standard beige fabric bandage, and the other is a patterned bandage with pink/orange floral designs. A portion of another person wearing a red shirt is visible in the background against a blue sky.
